primaryOutcomes.measure: To assess the effect of relutrigine on seizure frequency in participants with DEEs compared to placebo

reasons: one of only 8 trials at this company

signals.text: Primary completion pushed out 8 months vs original registration (Jun 2025): Apr 2026 to Dec 2026 (1 move on record)
signals.read: Moderate delay. One slip is common; repeated slips are the signal.

trials.commentary: Ph 3, randomized, double-blind. Targeting 160 patients. Started Jul 2025 (planned Jun 2025), primary completion Dec 2026 vs Apr 2026 at registration (+8 mo, 1 moves); planned 0.8 yrs, now 1.4 yrs. Recruiting opened Jul 2025, enrollment closed Jul 2026 (12 mo recruiting). Enrollment has been closed 3 months; the next event is data.
